name: Ethylene Oxide Synthesis
mechanism: Oxidize qualified ethene over a separately qualified supported silver catalyst and separate ethylene oxide from competing reaction products.
operating_requirement: Pay named ethene and oxygen feeds, reaction/cooling capacity, catalyst preparation and replacement, separation work and product checks; retain competing oxidation and rejected fractions.
consequence: Supply a specified ethylene-oxide feed to known glycol or ring-opening polymer processes; a methanol-conversion catalyst or generic olefin stream is not interchangeable.
branching_note: These are selected game production pathways, not claims that other historical implementations are impossible. All listed foundations apply; knowledge never supplies equipment or materials.
recovery: Acquire attributable ethylene oxide synthesis instruction or working samples, then pay for local setup and acceptance trials.

recovery_contract.local_demonstration: Oxidize qualified ethene over a separately qualified supported silver catalyst and separate ethylene oxide from competing reaction products.
recovery_contract.operating_requirements: Pay named ethene and oxygen feeds, reaction/cooling capacity, catalyst preparation and replacement, separation work and product checks; retain competing oxidation and rejected fractions.

route_terms.scholar_envoy: Pay a reachable specialist, travel, consumable practice stock and supervised local ethylene oxide synthesis trials.
route_terms.partnership: Share actual samples and operator time for ethylene oxide synthesis; independently inspect the partner output.
route_terms.purchased_research: Fund a bounded ethylene oxide synthesis process trial with recorded materials, failures and output checks.
route_terms.licensed_or_imported_service: Pay for finite external ethylene oxide synthesis processing; delivered material does not grant local manufacture.
route_terms.reverse_engineering: Inspect an attributable ethylene oxide synthesis machine or processed sample and pay to reproduce its result; hidden settings may prevent success.

implementation_status: Authored proposal only. Promotion requires paid capital, actual typed feed and output lots, finite work/energy/material accounting, quality failures, saved partial state and the downstream consumer described above. Neither a catalog row nor a global percentage bonus establishes operation.
historical_scope: H04 classifies this chosen operational capability, not an invention date or calendar unlock. Sources support the short mechanism description; game prerequisites, named ledger states and acceptance contracts are design inferences.

name: Ethylene Glycol Hydrolysis
mechanism: React a defined ethylene-oxide feed with water and separate monoethylene glycol from the resulting product mixture.
operating_requirement: Pay actual oxide, water, controlled reaction and separation work, heat/cooling and grade checks; retain higher-glycol fractions and losses rather than claiming complete selective conversion.
consequence: Supply qualified glycol to the specified polymer initiation or formulation consumer; imported oxide permits this known process without teaching oxide synthesis, and generic alcohol cannot substitute.
branching_note: These are selected game production pathways, not claims that other historical implementations are impossible. All listed foundations apply; knowledge never supplies equipment or materials.
recovery: Acquire attributable ethylene glycol hydrolysis instruction or working samples, then pay for local setup and acceptance trials.
